text: The old traveler straightened his back, his cloudy eyes clearing to reveal eyes like deep river pools.
'Your heart is a living well, child,' the elder smiled.
The golden weaver bird fluttered ahead, singing a crystal melody that parted the thickest thorn thickets.
Following the flight, Alieu was led into a hidden valley where a single magnificent palm tree stood, its fronds spun of shimmering golden threads and its dates glowing like amber lamps.
The elder instructed Alieu to gather three fallen golden dates and return in peace.
